title: Hair Cortisol Analysis Protocol
author: Katy Parker
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bqevmte6
materials: Rack samples and position horizontally on platform shaker.
Uncap samples and load into Scanvac vacuum centrifuge.

steps.title: Calibrate analytical balance
steps.instruction: Ensure the analytical balance is calibrated before use.

steps.title: Place beaker and tube
steps.instruction: Place a clean beaker on the balance, put a barcoded 4.5 ml sample tube (ThermoFisher Scientific 342800-0045) in the beaker and tare.

steps.title: Prepare length measurement card
steps.instruction: Measure the required hair length on a plastic card and mark the length with a permanent pen.

steps.title: Cut hair to measured length
steps.instruction: Hold the scalp end of the hair on the marked line, pull the hair taut and cut at the edge of the measure using sharp scissors; clean the scissors with 70 % IMS after use.

steps.title: Transfer hair to tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the cut hair sample to the sample tube using clean tweezers.

steps.title: Adjust hair mass to ~25 mg
steps.instruction: Add or remove hair with tweezers to obtain as close as possible to 25 mg; record the exact weight. For samples <25 mg transfer the whole sample and record its weight, then cap the tube.

steps.title: Add first isopropanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 2 ml isopropanol (Propan‑2‑ol, ≥99.8 %, CAS 67‑63‑0) to each tube in batches of approximately 10 samples, replace the cap, and keep soak time no longer than 5–10 minutes.

steps.title: Shake isopropanol batch
steps.instruction: Shake the batch on a platform shaker for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Remove isopropanol (first)
steps.instruction: Remove the isopropanol with a pipette and long tips, taking care not to aspirate any hair.

steps.title: Add second isopropanol wash
steps.instruction: Add another 2 ml isopropanol to each tube in the batch and replace the cap.

steps.title: Remove isopropanol (second)
steps.instruction: Remove the isopropanol with a pipette using a 1250 µl tip (Sarstedt 70.1186.100), ensuring no hair is removed.

steps.title: Dry tubes uncapped
steps.instruction: Leave the samples uncapped in a fume cabinet at room temperature for a minimum of 48 hours to dry completely.

steps.title: Add ceramic beads
steps.instruction: Add 3 × ceramic balls (MP Biomedicals 116959050) to each sample and securely replace the cap.

steps.title: Mechanical grinding
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a FastPrep‑24 (MP Biomedicals) and grind 6 times at 6 m s⁻¹ for 30 seconds each, allowing a 5‑minute cool‑down between grinds.

steps.title: Add methanol extraction solvent
steps.instruction: Add 2 ml methanol (analytical reagent grade, CAS 67‑56‑1) to each tube and tighten the caps.

steps.title: Methanol extraction shaking
steps.instruction: Shake continuously for 24 hours at room temperature to extract cortisol.

steps.title: Transfer to Salivette insert
steps.instruction: After incubation, remove the tubes from the shaker, shake the tube contents (hair powder, methanol, ceramic balls) into the insert of a pre‑labelled Salivette tube (Sarstedt 51.1534).

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the Salivettes at 1500 RCF for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Discard ceramic inserts
steps.instruction: Dispose of the Salivette inserts containing the ceramic balls and replace the caps on the tubes.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the Salivettes (now containing methanol and hair powder) at 3000 RCF for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Collect methanol supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 1.4 ml clear methanol supernatant to a pre‑labelled 2 ml tube (VWR 211‑0093) and cap the transferred samples.

steps.title: Evaporate methanol
steps.instruction: Run at 1700 RPM for 3 hours at 37 °C to completely dry the methanol.

steps.title: Store dried extracts
steps.instruction: Replace caps and store the dried extracts at –80 °C until the day of assay.

steps.title: Reconstitute for assay
steps.instruction: On the assay day, add 150 µl Salimetrics assay diluent to each tube and replace the caps.

steps.title: Vortex and invert (first)
steps.instruction: Vortex the samples for 10 seconds, invert, then vortex for an additional 10 seconds.

steps.title: Rest after vortex
steps.instruction: Allow the samples to sit for a minimum of 20 minutes after vortexing.

steps.title: Vortex before assay
steps.instruction: Immediately before the assay, vortex for 10 seconds, invert, and vortex again for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Final centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 1200 RCF for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Salimetrics assay
steps.instruction: Assay the samples according to the Salimetrics assay protocol.

steps.title: Final shake before cleanup
steps.instruction: Shake the batch of samples on a platform shaker for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Clean tools and repeat
steps.instruction: Clean tweezers with 70 % IMS, ensure the balance is clean, and repeat from step 4 with remaining samples.
